mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate increases by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings decline.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the unemployment rate increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over three consecutive months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic activity and consumer confidence improve.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where housing starts increase for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% in a month indicates a contraction in supply, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the potential economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where industrial production decreases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investor confidence in economic stability grows.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL remains below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in a month, combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate, signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate decreases.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP growth exceeding 3% on a quarterly basis signals strong economic demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings and consumer spending increase.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the quarters where real GDP growth exceeds 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate combined with an increase in real GDP signals a supportive monetary policy in a growing economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic activity and corporate earnings improve.
regime_hint: economic expansion with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate decreases and real GDP increases.
